title: SHARPENED SPECTRAL ENVELOPE: |H(w)| >= max(0, 1 - w^2 E[D^2]/2) and the line-moment-only form via J05
theorem: cos x = 1 - x^2/2 + O(x^4): the frozen T3 linear envelope is asymptotically weak at w->0; the quadratic envelope is asymptotically exact (log-log slope 3.99 ~ O(w^4)); T3'' substitutes L = 3E[Dv^2]^2/E[v^4] (J05) for a density-free bound
verified: 20/20: |H| >= T3 and T3' at w=0.25..8 on 4 clouds (uniform/q3/q10 central + volume); T3' > T3 strictly below w* = 2E[D]/E[D^2] = 1.31 (uniform); line-moment L <= E[D^2] holds
falsifier: any measured |H(w)| below the line-moment envelope 1 - w^2 L/2 at w E[D] < 1.5, with the lane's applicability conditions verified, kills the conservative Thomson-scattering reading
status: LANDED 20/20; frozen Thm-3 upgraded to a quadratic asymptotically-exact line-moment-only bound
